do_not: Ava CFD as future or spot

hypotheses.cost: one-way 2 bps research cost on futures-equivalent; no leverage
hypotheses.dataset: Databento GLBX.MDP3 GC.FUT+CL.FUT ohlcv-1d + definition + statistics
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Backwardation / curve inversion prices scarcity, inventory tightness, and convenience yield. This is futures term structure, not price momentum.
hypotheses.failure_gate: If FALSIFIED, do not retune slope, threshold, or hold. Next information = options or macro.
hypotheses.feature: curve_slope < 0 using official settlement of two nearest outrights
hypotheses.hypothesis: When the exchange curve is backwardated (front settlement above second), next-session front future return is positive after cost.
hypotheses.name: BACKWARDATION_TIGHTNESS
hypotheses.target: next-session front contract log return after settlement knowledge_time
hypotheses.validation: pre-registered; leakage; determinism; lineage; FDR q=0.05; four Xavier

hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Steepening is a change in the term structure, not the level of price. It reflects easing tightness / rising storage-financing compensation.
hypotheses.failure_gate: No hold/threshold search. Do not flip to flattening as a rescue.
hypotheses.hypothesis: A one-day increase in curve slope (steepening toward contango) predicts a negative next-session front return.
hypotheses.name: STEEPENING_SHOCK
hypotheses.target: next-session front log return after knowledge_time
hypotheses.validation: same gates; not a z_cut search

hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Positive roll yield and exchange basis between two listed exchange contracts. The spot leg must also be exchange-derived.
hypotheses.failure_gate: If failed, do not replace F2 with Ava CFD. Next family is options or OI-only if unused.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Positive front-second roll yield predicts positive next-session front return (carry harvested, not CFD overnight).
hypotheses.name: POSITIVE_ROLL_YIELD
hypotheses.target: next-session front log return after knowledge_time
